title: Infantry step through their turns
summary: Infantry ease through reversals and reposition their boots on a standing turn.
stage: Native Forward+ at 30 fps and seed 3. A lone rifleman reverses at 1.16 seconds and receives a new heading at 3.1 seconds. The final shot is the untrimmed village street crossing at 23.3 seconds in the source take.
rationale: Matched cameras and real-time playback show the foot placement during the half-turn and make the change visible at squad scale.
source_ref: Edition 48 street take and gameplay baseline aec37ddc with its smoke and vehicle changes. After adds the infantry presentation changes. Both runs receive the same commands.
